pendingSwitchAccessor.impl:
/**
   * Read the in-flight preset switch guard for one session, or `undefined`
   * when no {@link select} is queued.
   *
   * Resolves when the switch's `swap` (recompose + record) has committed and
   * the `switches` entry is deleted in `select`'s finally; never rejects —
   * `select` stores `turn.catch(() => undefined)` (index.ts:699) so a refused
   * switch does not poison the next awaiter. Returns `undefined` once settled.
   *
   * Additive read-only accessor: the data-agent-scoped pre-step guard awaits
   * this before a turn's first step assembles, restoring the deleted apiproxy
   * turn-path `await pendingSwitch` (packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:2397,
   * removed by upstream 4f00a8b) in the DATA-AGENT layer rather than in
   * generic session-controller. Leaves `@Remote('select')` (:694-706), the
   * private `switches` Map (:684), and `swap` (:709) untouched.
   *
   * @param sessionId - the session id (=== agent.id; select uses agent.id as the Map key at :697/:700/:704).
   * @returns the in-flight guard Promise, or `undefined` when no switch is queued.
   */
  pendingSwitch(sessionId: string): Promise<unknown> | undefined {
    return this.switches.get(sessionId)
  }
pendingSwitchAccessor.lineRange: insert as a public method immediately after `select()` closes at :706 (or adjacent to the private `switches` Map field at :684); class `AgentPresets` declared at :100 (extends TypertRemoteService); `@Remote('select')` handler at :694-706 stays untouched; `ctx.agentPresets: AgentPresets` Context augmentation at :89
pendingSwitchAccessor.verifiedAgainstSource: HEAD 6695ed150e. `private readonly switches = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>()` confirmed at :684 (private — no cross-package accessor). git grep pendingSwitch|switches.get|awaitSwitch|drain across packages/api/session-controller/src = ZERO preset-switch hits (only unrelated drainSessionDisposals manager.ts:263/276 + drainScopeDrops service.ts:260/673). `select(agent: Agent, agentPreset: string)` at :694 uses `this.switches.get(agent.id)` (:697), `.set(agent.id, guard)` (:700), `.delete(agent.id)` (:704); `agent.id === sessionId` confirmed at :719-720 (RemoteError options `sessionId: agent.id`). Guard `turn.catch(() => undefined)` at :699 means the returned Promise never rejects → pendingSwitch's await is safe. Accessor is read-only (returns the existing Map entry) — no mutation of select/swap/switches semantics.

presetAutojoinGuard.awaitsExpression: const pending = ctx.agentPresets.pendingSwitch?.(agent.id); if (pending !== undefined) await pending  // executed BEFORE `return next()` inside the agent/pre-step middleware listener. `agent` comes from the pre-step payload `({ agent, ... }, next)`; agent.id === sessionId (verified agent-presets:719-720). Optional-chaining `?.` keeps the guard a no-op when the accessor is absent (e.g. a test mock that didn't stub pendingSwitch).

steps: 1. Start a NEW conversation (fresh session id) in the data-agent host.

2. Select 取数模式 (the `data-agent` agent preset) via the preset select RPC — fires `@Remote('select')` (agent-presets:694) which queues the swap, writes the `agent-preset/selected` event (agent-presets:726), and recomposes the agent scope (recompose :650 → binding.rebind :661).

3. IMMEDIATELY send the first user prompt (race the select) — prompt() at session-controller/commands.ts:294 resolves the agent and dispatches agent.steer/agent.followup at :348-349 with NO await of the in-flight switch (verified: the admit() path at :321-360 awaits only image/model/attachment validation, never pendingSwitch).
4. Let the turn settle (whether it interrupts or completes).
5. Locate the session JSONL artifact under the configured root (~/.dsh/storages/sessions/<sessionId>/ — see path field).
6. Find the first `turn/end` line and read its `data.reason` (a TurnEndReason per core/session/src/types.ts:198-222) — branch on reason.kind as described in howToReadTurnEnd.
jsonlCaptureProtocol.expectedKind: disposed (validates the observer-fix). PRECISELY: turn/end `data.reason.kind === 'aborted'` AND `data.reason.reason.kind === 'disposed'` → the abort source was `machine.cancel({ kind: 'disposed' })` at agent-loop/src/index.ts:591 (fiber-lifecycle disposal, exactly as B-DA1 concluded), which confirms the observer-fix is the right remedy. IF instead `data.reason.kind === 'error'` (with `data.reason.error` a LlmFailure, types.ts:209) → that is Hypothesis B: the LLM/DashScope connection is failing (orthogonal to the preset-switch race), and the observer-fix alone is INSUFFICIENT — an LLM-wiring fix is additionally required. (Within the aborted branch, `reason.reason.kind === 'user'` would indicate the commands.ts:486 user-cancel path, and `'hook'` the phase-gate.ts:897 300s stall — both ruled out on a first message per decision-doc point 2.) The decision-doc's `expected=disposed vs error` is shorthand for this aborted+disposed vs error branch.
jsonlCaptureProtocol.howToReadTurnEnd: Each JSONL line is one SessionEvent `{ type, seq, time, data, ... }` (session-persistence-jsonl). Find the line where `type === 'turn/end'` for the FIRST turn (lowest seq with that type). Read `data.reason` (typed TurnEndReason, packages/core/session/src/types.ts:222 = TurnEndReasonMap[keyof] at :198-222; turn/end data shape `{ turn: number; reason: TurnEndReason }` at :282). BRANCH ON `data.reason.kind` FIRST — the decision-doc's `turn/end.reason.reason.kind` shorthand only exists in the aborted branch: (a) `reason.kind === 'aborted'` → descend into `reason.reason.kind` (TurnEndCancelCause, types.ts:187-190: 'user'|'hook'|'disposed'); expect 'disposed'. (b) `reason.kind === 'error'` → Hypothesis B (read `reason.error` LlmFailure, types.ts:209); observer-fix alone insufficient. (c) `reason.kind === 'completed'` (types.ts:199) → no abort occurred (the repro did not reproduce — the race lost). (d) `'max-tokens'` / 'blocked' / crash-closer → not the B-DA1 abort. The fixture at packages/client/connection/src/client/fixture.ts:3001-3004 shows the exact shape `reason: aborted ? { kind: 'aborted', reason: { kind: 'user' } } : { kind: 'completed' }` (fixture simulates 'user'; a real disposal produces 'disposed' at the same nested path). headless/src/index.ts:86 confirms the read is `event.data.reason`.
jsonlCaptureProtocol.path: ~/.dsh/storages/sessions/<sessionId>/ (B-DA1 ticket:80,:152 cites `~/.dsh/storages/sessions/<id>.jsonl` as the conventional shorthand). The JSONL backend's root is CONFIG-PROVIDED — `packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts:90-96` declares `root: string` required with no default; the data-agent host composition configures it to ~/.dsh/storages/sessions. The backend resolves the current-generation artifact via `resolveCurrentLog(id)` (storage.ts:52) using `logPath(this.root, meta.cwd, meta.id, this.compression)` (index.ts:294) under a per-session directory `sessionDir(this.root, cwd, id)` (index.ts:872) — so the on-disk file is `<root>/<sessionDir>/<gen>.jsonl`. <sessionId> === agent.id. If the operator cannot find the file at the conventional path, resolve the actual root from the host's persistence config or `$DSH_HOME` (the harness home defaults to `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh` per attachment-local:62, credentials-keychain:94, agent-instructions/config.ts:19).

fixtures.name: select-vs-prompt race (first turn sees final tool set)
fixtures.what: ADD a test that a `select` racing a turn-start prompt awaits the in-flight switch: the first turn's first step observes the FINAL (post-switch) tool set, not the pre-switch one. Currently only `:380` 'serializes two concurrent switches on one session' (select-vs-select) and `:397-404` 'refuses once the conversation has started' (agent-preset/locked) exist — the actual B-DA1 select+prompt race is untested. This is the canonical regression test for the observer-fix.
fixtures.asserts: the first step/start (and its tool definitions) reflect the swapped preset; the `agent-preset/selected` event (:726) precedes the first `step/start`; no tool-call block is left with `error: { name: 'Interrupted', code: 'interrupted' }` (ui-trajectory/.../trajectory-tool-definition.ts:190-197); the prompt did not assemble on the pre-switch scope chain.

(REFINEMENT: the decision-doc suggested packages/preset/agent-presets/tests/session.spec.ts, but that file is PROJECTION-only — it tests the `agent-preset/selected` session projection at :20-40, NOT the AgentPresets service. remote.spec.ts is the service test that drives `ctx.agentPresets.select` at :377-394, so the accessor contract belongs here.)

fixtures.name: rebind-during-chain-walk (snapshot vs torn read)

recommendation:
Land the OBSERVER-FIX in the data-agent layer (NOT Remote-serialization — minimizes upstream drift, confines coupling to the da-scoped wrapper, and is the lower-regret reversible path per decision-doc grounds 1-4). Do the JSONL capture (d) FIRST as a prerequisite. Concrete landing:

(a) Add the additive read-only `pendingSwitch(sessionId)` accessor to AgentPresets at packages/preset/agent-presets/src/index.ts (insert after the `select()` close at :706; reads the private `switches` Map at :684; leaves `@Remote('select')` :694-706 and `swap` :709 untouched). Confirmed private/unreachable cross-package (git grep across session-controller = zero preset-switch hits).

(b) Add an `agent/pre-step` guard in preset-autojoin's `apply()` at packages/data/preset-autojoin/src/index.ts:147-162 that does `const pending = ctx.agentPresets.pendingSwitch?.(agent.id); if (pending !== undefined) await pending` before `return next()`. This restores the deleted apiproxy turn-path `await pendingSwitch` (api-proxy.ts:2397, removed by upstream 4f00a8b) in the data-agent layer. CRITICAL: the guard goes on `agent/pre-step` (an AWAITED middleware — verified: compaction:148, agent-instructions:313, +8 others return `Promise<PreStepDecision>` and chain via `next()`), NOT on `agent/created` (preset-autojoin's own source :14-21 documents `agent/created` is fire-and-forget — the framework does NOT await listeners — so a guard there would NOT block the step). The guard is naturally first-turn-scoped and a no-op when no switch is in-flight (past the first turn, `swap` throws `agent-preset/locked` at agent-presets:715-722). Extend the `AutojoinPresetService` structural interface (:50-72) with an optional `pendingSwitch?` member for test mocks.

(c) Harden the scope observer: add `scopeChainSnapshotOf(key)` (frozen readonly snapshot) to packages/core/scope/src/index.ts and migrate any standing-mount/observer parent-chain read that spans an await (notably in agent-presets `ensureStanding`/`recompose` at :656/:650-672) to use it. scopeParents is a WeakMap (:39, confirming decision-doc's 'WeakMap write' claim); `binding.rebind()` (:78-80) → `linkScopeParent` (:54-58) → `scopeParents.set` (:58) is a synchronous write with zero side effects (re-confirmed B-DA1 Hypothesis-A refutation: recompose does NOT cancel the agent).

(d) PREREQUISITE FIRST: capture a live session JSONL on the B-DA1 repro (new conversation → select 取数模式 → send) and read `turn/end.data.reason`: `reason.kind==='aborted' && reason.reason.kind==='disposed'` validates the observer-fix; `reason.kind==='error'` is Hypothesis B (LLM/DashScope wiring, orthogonal) and requires an ADDITIONAL fix beyond the observer-fix. The race is currently established by architecture trace only (prompt() at commands.ts:294-360 dispatches `agent.steer/agent.followup` at :348-349 with NO await of the in-flight switch — VERIFIED), not by a captured trajectory.

Commit with `-F` and explicit paths per tracker discipline. Tests: the 5 fixtures above across agent-presets, preset-autojoin, dsh-scope, and connection."
openQuestions: disposed vs error (SOLE remaining uncertainty): the runtime JSONL capture is the only open question. If turn/end.data.reason.kind === 'error' (Hypothesis B), the observer-fix alone is insufficient — an LLM/DashScope wiring fix is additionally required. The capture is the explicit prerequisite (decision-doc step 4) and resolves it. Race mechanism itself is high-confidence: confirmed by architecture trace that prompt() at commands.ts:294-360 dispatches agent.steer/agent.followup at :348-349 with NO await of the in-flight switch, and the switches Map is private at agent-presets:684 with no cross-package accessor.

agent/pre-step listener ordering: preset-autojoin's guard must effectively settle the switch before any downstream listener walks the scope chain across an await. Cordis ctx.on order = registration order = bundle-load order; verify preset-autojoin loads before compaction/agent-instructions in the data-agent composition, OR rely on the guard being self-sufficient (it awaits pendingSwitch which only resolves after binding.rebind at agent-presets:661, so by next() the chain is final regardless of downstream listeners — but a listener registered BEFORE preset-autojoin that reads the chain before its own next() is still exposed; the scopeChainSnapshotOf hardening (c) is the defense-in-depth for that case).
